text.content:
A storeroom-turned-danger-zone: shelving has collapsed across half the room, and something under the wreckage is still moving. It isn't hostile so much as extremely enthusiastic - a llama, wedged under a fallen beam, spitting with real accuracy at anything that gets close.

GM Notes

Substory beat: This is Mudflap, the llama who discovered that a well-aimed spit at a goblin earns double rations from the current administration (goblins bribe the herd for peace the same way they bribe each other). Mudflap has begun training the rest of the pen in the technique, which is quietly destabilizing the warren's already-thin food economy. She is not actually trapped badly - freeing her (Athletics or similar to shift the beam) takes one action.

Encounter: This room re-arms itself on later visits: fresh debris, or a fresh llama, on the same random-encounter table used for the rest of the floor.

Subquest - Mudflap's Union: Freeing Mudflap earns a genuinely grateful (and extremely wet) llama ally who will follow the party for the rest of this floor and spit on command at anything hostile once per encounter (flavor first, mechanical bonus at your discretion). Leaving her trapped is also fine - some other adventurer, or goblin, will get to her eventually.
